outcome: oral microbiota (loads of selected bacterial species)
colonization of bacteria potentially responsible for VAP
cohort: Thirty extremely preterm infants (born <= 30 weeks gestation) hospitalized in a NICU.
finding: Oral care with breast milk significantly increased lactoferrin and sIgA concentrations in vivo, and the lactoferrin concentrations obtained in vitro reduced loads of common VAP-causing bacteria, although no in vivo effect on bacterial colonization was found.
